name: NeRF Optimization via SDS
definition: Optimizes a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) model parameters to match a text prompt using SDS gradients, incorporating view-dependent text conditioning and regularization terms.
summary: NeRF Optimization via SDS uses Score Distillation Sampling from a 2D diffusion model to optimize NeRF parameters for text prompts, distinguished by view-dependent text conditioning and specific regularization terms.
